initial_state: No task implementation, test execution, review approval, or platform qualification is implied by this tracker.
authority: User authorization to implement is required before source changes. Real-data destructive actions, live credentials and publishing require separate human authorization.
shared_scope: Only task-specific status, evidence and truthful capability disclosures; no blanket authorization to rewrite shared documents. Reserve shared paths before editing.

global_gates.name: all_tests

gate_protocol: Every test_gates entry and required_assertions scenario is a future required deliverable, not an existing pass. Enumerate exact top-level test names, run anchored commands with -json and require run/pass with no skipped required subcases. Record which executed fixture proves each required_assertions scenario. Missing packages/tests, skipped scenarios and no-tests-to-run fail the gate; passing only the top-level name does not prove scenario coverage.

review_policy.rule: Resolve the requested model through available model discovery; never silently substitute. Stop after two correction rounds or unavailable independent reviewer. No implementer or release builder approves its own output.

tasks.name: Bounded full-snapshot contract
required_assertions: TestManifestRefsAndHead accepts exactly kind=absent without target/oid, rejects contradictory fields, and distinguishes schema representation from Git restoration support.
tasks.purpose: Establish one portable, bounded interpretation before producing artifacts.
steps: Define full-only versioned manifests, safe artifact names, IDs, UTC timestamps, byte size and SHA-256; reject prerequisites.
Represent every captured valid ref with raw OID, annotated tags unpeeled, SHA-1/SHA-256, and symbolic/detached/unborn/absent HEAD independently.
Bound bytes, refs, names and metadata; reject duplicate keys/refs, trailing JSON, invalid encoding, unsafe names and contradictory fields.
Return separate operation outcome, publication identity/state, verification dimensions and warnings; permit valid extra packed objects while requiring integrity.
tasks.config_ownership: Concrete backup-owned limits and options only. No internal/config until I05; artifact rules are not configurable bypasses.
tasks.failure_cancel_restart: Invalid/unsupported manifests fail before effects. Parser bounds survive hostile input. No durable effects to cancel or reconcile.
stop_conditions: Unapproved ref/HEAD coverage reduction
Unjustified ref grammar or format rule
Scope expansion or two failed correction attempts
